sources.title: Broncos place rookie RB Jonah Coleman on the short-term IR due to a high-ankle sprain
sources.description: Well, this sucks. According to ESPN’s lead NFL insider Adam Schefter, the Denver Broncos are placing rookie running back Jonah Coleman on the short-term IR due to a high-ankle sprain that he suffered during their Week 2 victory over the Jaguars.
